question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute a tankless water heater in lieu of the storage-type unit specified in Section 22 34 00 prior to fixture rough-in and material ordering.
proposed_solution: Use a tankless water heater in place of the specified storage-type unit.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: The substitution involves a domestic water heater assembly governed by Division 22 plumbing specifications, requiring the plumbing engineer's approval for equivalent performance and code compliance.
